tweaks.apply_failed_desc: The change was not saved. Please try again.
tweaks.classic_context_menu_desc: Restores full-size Windows 10 style context menu instead of the compact Windows 11 menu.
tweaks.classic_context_menu_side_effect: Winsentials enables the classic menu through a per-user Windows registry setting without modifying themes or system files. If Windhawk, StartAllBack, ExplorerPatcher, or another application already patches the menu, this tweak may have no visible effect or cause visual artifacts such as square corners, lost transparency, or other styling differences.
tweaks.disable_menu_delay_desc: Sets menu opening delay to 0 ms for instant responsiveness.
tweaks.create_symlink_desc: Adds a context menu item to quickly create a symbolic link for any file or folder with destination folder picker.
tweaks.take_ownership_desc: Adds a context menu item to quickly take ownership of files and folders and grant full control permissions to Administrators.
tweaks.take_ownership_side_effect: The tweak only adds a command and changes nothing automatically. Do not use it on system or other critical files and folders unless necessary: changing ownership and granting Administrators full control modifies permissions and may disrupt resource protection, update installation, services, or system applications.
tweaks.copy_image_desc: Adds an image context-menu command that copies the image itself instead of the file, ready to paste into a messenger, editor, or document.
tweaks.open_to_this_pc_desc: Opens File Explorer to «This PC» folder instead of default «Home» start page.
tweaks.hide_network_desc: Removes the Network item from the File Explorer navigation pane.
tweaks.hide_home_desc: Removes the Home item from the File Explorer navigation pane.
tweaks.hide_gallery_desc: Removes the Gallery section from the File Explorer navigation pane.
tweaks.hide_linux_desc: Removes the WSL Linux item from the File Explorer navigation pane.
tweaks.remove_shortcut_arrows_desc: Removes the arrow icon overlay from desktop and explorer shortcuts.
tweaks.remove_shortcut_suffix_desc: Prevents Windows from appending «- Shortcut» to newly created shortcuts.
tweaks.disable_jpeg_compression_desc: Prevents Windows from compressing desktop wallpaper quality down to 85%, preserving 100% full quality.
tweaks.disable_mouse_acceleration_desc: Disables pointer precision enhancement (acceleration) for 1:1 linear and accurate cursor response.
tweaks.csrss_priority_desc: Assigns High CPU and I/O priority to the csrss.exe subsystem in Image File Execution Options, minimizing mouse and keyboard input latency under heavy CPU load.
tweaks.keyboard_repeat_desc: Adjusts the delay before a held key starts repeating and the rate of subsequent keystrokes. Faster presets make input more responsive, while gentler ones suit everyday typing.
tweaks.ctf_optimization_desc: Text Services Framework (ctfmon.exe) intercepts every keystroke for handwriting and IME pipelines. Modes: Standard — default Windows behavior; Mild — disables MsCtfMonitor task keeping language bar active; Aggressive — fully unloads TSF (hides taskbar language icon).
tweaks.ctf_side_effect_mild: Disables the MsCtfMonitor scheduled task. Taskbar language selector and layout switching (Alt+Shift, Win+Space) remain functional. Touch and pen input may be disabled.
tweaks.ctf_side_effect_aggressive: Fully unloads TSF via Thread Input Manager. Warning: the taskbar language icon is removed, and layout switching in modern UWP/XAML apps (Start search, Settings) may require a third-party switcher.
tweaks.snapkey_desc: Interrupts the previous movement key when pressing an opposing one (SOCD Last Input Priority, similar to Razer Snap Tap & Wooting Snappy Tappy) for instant counter-strafing without physical release delay. Runs in the background while the app is open or minimized to tray.
tweaks.snapkey_tray_toast_desc: SnapKey runs in the background. Enable 'Minimize to tray' so it keeps working when the application window is closed.
tweaks.snapkey_side_effect: Some games (like Counter-Strike 2) detect input automation and kick players from the match with a 'Kicked for input automation' warning (without an account ban). However, in certain games (like osu!), using SOCD/Snap Tap is strictly prohibited and will lead to an account ban. Always check game rules before using!
tweaks.disable_uac_desc: Disables User Account Control and Admin Approval Mode so applications can run without elevation prompts.
tweaks.disable_uac_side_effect: Admin Approval Mode is disabled. Some applications may refuse to start or operate with elevated privileges.
tweaks.disable_download_warning_desc: Stops Windows from marking files as downloaded from the Internet and showing the potentially harmful file warning.
tweaks.disable_download_warning_side_effect: Windows cannot fully assess risk from the file's origin zone; SmartScreen and applications might not recognize it as an Internet download.
tweaks.disable_removable_autoplay_desc: Prevents content from removable drives and optical media from starting automatically.
tweaks.disable_quick_access_history_desc: Hides recently used files and frequently opened folders from File Explorer Quick Access.
tweaks.disable_security_center_notifications_de: Hides the Windows Security notification-area icon and disables messages about antivirus, firewall, and other protection components.
tweaks.disable_security_center_notifications_si: Windows will stop showing important protection warnings in the notification area. Security status must be checked manually.
tweaks.disable_startup_delay_desc: Removes the delay before File Explorer launches startup apps after sign-in. It does not affect kernel, driver, or service startup.
tweaks.disable_startup_delay_side_effect: Startup apps will launch immediately after sign-in, so the desktop may respond more slowly for a short time on lower-end systems.
tweaks.restart_explorer_desc: Restarting explorer.exe is required for changes to take effect.
tweaks.logoff_desc: Signing out of your Windows account is required for changes to take effect.
tweaks.reboot_desc: Restarting your computer is required for changes to take effect.
tweaks.badge_restart_explorer_tooltip: Restarting File Explorer (explorer.exe) is required for changes to take effect.
tweaks.badge_logoff_tooltip: Signing out of your Windows account is required for changes to take effect.
tweaks.badge_reboot_tooltip: Restarting your computer is required for changes to take effect.
tweaks.badge_win11_tooltip: This tweak is available exclusively on Windows 11 (Build 22000+)
tweaks.bbr2_desc: Enables Google's BBRv2 congestion control algorithm for lower latency and higher throughput, while disabling LargeLoopbackMTU to keep local connections stable
tweaks.rss_desc: Distributes network receive processing across all CPU cores instead of a single core, reducing latency and CPU bottlenecks
tweaks.fast_send_copy_title: AFD Fast Send & Fast Copy (Fast I/O)
tweaks.fast_send_copy_desc: Increases AFD fast-path socket buffers (FastSendDatagramThreshold and FastCopyReceiveThreshold) up to 64 KB, bypassing kernel queuing delays for sent and received packets to reduce latency and jitter in games and VoIP
tweaks.disable_ndu_desc: Disables the Network Diagnostic Usage driver (Ndu.sys) to prevent non-paged pool memory leaks, DPC latency spikes, and micro-stutters during heavy network traffic.
tweaks.disable_ndu_side_effect: Stops data usage tracking in Windows Settings -> Network & Internet -> Data usage and Task Manager App History tab.
